scope: Timor-Leste medical discovery — Nalanda College of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Nalanda College of Medicine's own site says it offers a Medicine and Surgery course leading to a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery and claims ministerial licensing.

holdReasons: The licensing claim has not been independently corroborated in the reviewed Timor-Leste government gazette or accreditation material.

No current fee schedule, duration/curriculum, admissions call, eligibility, teaching language, named clinical partners, accommodation, scholarship/loan support or graduate-registration evidence was found.
A self-published licence statement alone does not meet the site’s commercial-content evidence threshold.
nextAction: Locate the cited ministerial decree/gazette and the current programme/accreditation, fees, admissions and clinical-training records before reconsidering this candidate.
